name: chassis-delegation
description: Delegate coding tasks to verified Claude workers: tiering, verification, background debrief and eval, dashboard

autoEscalate.title: Auto-escalate
autoEscalate.description: On a failing verdict, resume the worker (first failure) without asking; a second failure prints the next spawn block (one tier up) for the brain to make, as the mod no longer spawns workers itself

applyAmends.title: Apply hand-back amends
applyAmends.description: Append the hand-back's scope+= / forbid+= amend blocks to the brief before verifying (the chassis amend protocol); a block with scope-= or forbid-= always waits for approval. Off lists every block on the verdict row instead

defaultBudget.title: Default budget
defaultBudget.description: Attempts per task when the brief names no budget=<n>-attempts: 3 covers a spawn, a resume, and a respawn one tier up

gateMap.title: Gate map (JSON)
gateMap.description: Brief gate= id to the command the verifier re-runs in the worker's worktree, by argv (no shell); {files} is files.txt; chain with " && ". No sf, git, gh, network, rm or publish. Ids the map lacks are named "gate not re-run". Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

mergeCheckMap.title: Merge checks (JSON)
mergeCheckMap.description: Gate id to the command /delegation merge runs in the worktree before it rebases, for a card whose gate list has that id (a card's own merge_check wins); by argv (no shell), same rules as the gate map; {card}, {sha} and {worktree} are filled in; a non-zero exit refuses the merge. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else none; a value here wins over both

probeModels.title: Probe candidate models
probeModels.description: Once a day, ask each candidate model id one token and toast the first time one answers

candidateIds.title: Candidate model ids
candidateIds.description: Comma-separated model ids to probe when Probe candidate models is on

briefDir.title: Brief folder
briefDir.description: Where /dispatch writes <TASK-ID>.brief.md; empty = <repo root>/.delegation/briefs/ (the session scratchpad briefs/ only when the root is not writable)

briefLocal.title: Local rules file
briefLocal.description: A gitignored file of rules (path relative to the repo root, or absolute) copied into every brief under a section the debrief drops; empty = the repo file's briefLocal, else none

briefTemplate.title: Brief template
briefTemplate.description: A template file for the brief body; empty = the repo file's briefTemplate, else the mod's hooks/templates/brief.md

agentTypes.title: Agent type per domain (JSON)
agentTypes.description: Card domain to the subagent type /dispatch spawns; built in: frontend and backend to their own, every other domain to general-purpose. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

tierMap.title: Tier map (JSON)
tierMap.description: Tier to model alias, e.g. {"standard":"opus"}; built in: economy haiku, standard sonnet, frontier opus (fable is never spawned, it becomes opus). Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

spendByTier.title: Spend ceiling per tier (JSON)
spendByTier.description: Dollars one attempt may spend, per tier, e.g. {"standard":8}; built in: economy 3, standard 10, frontier 25; 0 means no ceiling. /dispatch writes it as spend= in the brief (a card's own spend: wins); the mod warns the worker once at the ceiling and records over-spend at twice it. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

effortByTier.title: Effort per tier (JSON)
effortByTier.description: How hard a worker thinks at each step, per tier, e.g. {"standard":"high"}; built in: economy low, standard medium, frontier high; low, medium, high, xhigh or max, and 0 or empty leaves the engine's default. A card's own effort: wins. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

effortNudge.title: Effort nudge for you (JSON)
effortNudge.description: When a worker's report names an artefact under this glob (built in: the card folder, cardDir/**, agents/tasks/** on defaults), its handed-back row ends 'lead: judgment next, raise to high'; the verdict row that accepts a later task, or the next worker's started row, ends 'lead: back to medium'. Keys: cards (the glob; "" turns the nudge off), up and down (the effort words your model menu uses), e.g. {"cards":"renders/**","up":"xhigh"}. The mod never changes your model or effort. Empty = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Comma-separated card domains /dispatch accepts (each becomes agent/<domain>/<id>); built in: frontend, backend, ops, dispatcher, cross, shared. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

briefExtra.title: Brief extra lines
briefExtra.description: Lines the brief adds under its rules, for what only this repo needs (a gate script, a test command). Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

worktreeRoot.title: Worktree folder
worktreeRoot.description: Where /dispatch adds worktrees: <folder>/<repo name>-<id>; empty = beside the repo (<root>-<id>). Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

verdictVerbosity.title: Verdict verbosity
verdictVerbosity.description: line: one line per verdict (the claim lines go to the debug log); full: the verdict line plus the verifier's claim lines; silent: no row, a toast only

maxWorkers.title: Max workers
maxWorkers.description: Briefed workers that run at once (built in: 2); a briefed spawn past it is queued; the hand-back that frees a slot says ready: <id> and the brain makes the spawn (ad hoc spawns never wait). Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

gateTimeoutMinutes.title: Gate timeout minutes
gateTimeoutMinutes.description: Whole minutes (1 to 10) the verifier and /delegation merge let one gate command run before they stop it (built in: 9). Raise it for a repo whose full suite runs long, up to the 10 the host allows for one command. A value outside 1 to 10 is named in the config errors and 9 is used. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else 9; a value here wins over both

maxWorkersByTier.title: Max workers per tier (JSON)
maxWorkersByTier.description: A second, lower ceiling under maxWorkers for the briefed workers of one tier, e.g. {"frontier":2}; each value a whole number of 1 or more, tiers economy, standard, frontier, premium; a tier not named takes maxWorkers alone (built in: none). A spawn waits when its tier is full though the total has room, and a cheaper row behind it starts first. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else none; a value here wins over both

autoDebrief.title: Background debrief
autoDebrief.description: At a clean stop (idle, no worker, nothing pending or queued, enough friction, past the cooldown) a background agent writes a debrief: ~/.claude/commands/debrief.md when it exists, else the built-in hooks/templates/debrief.md into <root>/.delegation/debriefs/

debriefMode.title: Debrief mode (notes | transcript)
debriefMode.description: What the clean-stop debrief does. notes: no agent runs; once a round of verdicts has closed the mod adds one row asking you to write the review note (a section headed 'For the mod owner', one bullet per finding), then /delegation debrief ingest <note.md> turns the bullets into findings that /delegation debrief post reads. transcript: a background agent mines the session as before. autoDebrief false silences both

debriefIdleMinutes.title: Debrief idle minutes
debriefIdleMinutes.description: Minutes without a turn before the clean-stop check runs

debriefMinNewLines.title: Debrief new breadcrumb lines
debriefMinNewLines.description: With a harness breadcrumb file: the lines past its .done watermark a debrief needs

debriefMinEvents.title: Debrief friction events
debriefMinEvents.description: With no breadcrumb file: corrections typed (a prompt starting no/stop/don't/actually) + tool calls denied + refuted verdicts since the last debrief that a debrief needs

debriefCooldownHours.title: Debrief cooldown hours
debriefCooldownHours.description: Hours between two background debriefs of one session

debriefAgent.title: Debrief agent type
debriefAgent.description: The subagent type the background debrief runs as

redact.title: Redact list
redact.description: Comma-separated words (product, customer, employer, repo names) the debrief's findings scrub replaces with <redacted>, whole words, any case. Lives here and not in the repo file, which is public; the home path, the repo and its origin, and the git user are scrubbed without it

postFindings.title: Post findings (ask | auto | off)
postFindings.description: After a debrief hands back with new findings about the mod. ask: the mod asks you once whether to post them to the issue repo, and posts nothing without your yes. auto: it posts every new finding at once, scrubbed (needs the redact list set; at most 5 per debrief). off: no question, no posting; the drafts are still written. Posting runs gh as you, so this is yours: it is never read from the repo file

autoEval.title: Background eval
autoEval.description: When origin/main has moved and the session is idle, an eval-runner subagent runs evalCommand once per sha. Runs only when an evalCommand is set (here or in the repo file); the repo file can turn it on too

evalIdleMinutes.title: Eval idle minutes
evalIdleMinutes.description: Minutes without a turn before the eval trigger looks at origin/main

evalCommand.title: Eval command (T1)
evalCommand.description: What the eval runner subagent runs (the mod itself never runs it); none built in. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

evalLive.title: Live eval (T2)
evalLive.description: After a clean T1, run the live eval once a session within the cost ceiling

evalLiveCommand.title: Eval command (T2)
evalLiveCommand.description: What the live eval runner runs; none built in. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

evalLiveMaxUsd.title: Live eval ceiling (USD)
evalLiveMaxUsd.description: What one T2 run may spend; T2 runs only while the session cost plus this stays within the session cap

sessionUsdCap.title: Session cost cap (USD)
sessionUsdCap.description: T2 never starts when the session cost plus the T2 ceiling would pass this

evalAgent.title: Eval agent type
evalAgent.description: The subagent type the eval runner runs as

ledgerFile.title: Ledger file
ledgerFile.description: Append one JSON line per briefed spawn and one per judged attempt to <repo root>/.delegation/ledger.jsonl

gitGuard.title: Git guard
gitGuard.description: Deny a Bash git commit, merge, cherry-pick, rebase or push on a guarded branch (and a push naming one from any branch): branch first

guardBranches.title: Guarded branches
guardBranches.description: Comma-separated branches the git guard holds

baseRef.title: Base ref
baseRef.description: Where a brief's delta starts when it names no base=: a ref such as main or HEAD. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in chain origin/main, main, origin/master, master; a value here wins over both

ignore.title: Ignore globs (repo=here)
ignore.description: Comma-separated globs subtracted from a repo=here dirty-tree delta before the files= and scope checks, each disclosed on the ignored: line. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in .delegation/**; a value here wins over both

dashboardBand.title: Dashboard band
dashboardBand.description: Draw the delegation band above the prompt while a worker is live, queued or owed a verdict; hover it for the spend chart and worktrees, [ details ] opens the pane. Off (the default): no band above the prompt; /delegation dashboard still opens the pane

ration.title: Rationing meter (seven_day | five_hour | off)
ration.description: The rate-limit window the band's meter reads: a bar of the window (a cell per day, or per hour for five_hour), today's share of what is left and whether today is on pace. seven_day or five_hour name the window; off draws no meter. /delegation ration prints the report

rationDaily.title: Daily allowance (window points)
rationDaily.description: A fixed share of the window to spend each day, in points of the window (0 to 100); what an earlier day left unspent carries into today. 0 = pace to the reset: the points left over the days left

modelGlyphs.title: Model glyphs (alias=glyph pairs | off)
modelGlyphs.description: The glyph that marks each model on the host's subagent row and every mod row: alias=glyph pairs such as sonnet=🟦, off for none, empty for the built-in set (haiku 🟢, sonnet 🔵, opus 🟣, fable 🟠, other ⚪)

delegateOnly.title: Delegate only (off | warn | deny)
delegateOnly.description: Keep an opus or fable brain from doing worker work itself. warn: its Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and Bash writes into the repo run, and the mod posts one row per turn saying so; deny: they are refused, naming the card tool. The card folder, .delegation/, .chassis-delegation.json, CHANGELOG.md and any docs/ folder stay writable. A sonnet or haiku brain, and workers, are never restricted. Empty or off = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else warn; a value here wins over it. The one way to switch it off is "delegateOnly": "off" in the repo file (or /delegation config delegateOnly off when that writes the repo file)

cardDir.title: Card folder
cardDir.description: Where the task cards live, relative to the repo root (default agents/tasks). In a repo that is itself a plugin keep it out of agents/, which the engine reads as subagent definitions. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else the built-in default; a value here wins over both

classifierSecondOpinion.title: Classifier second opinion
classifierSecondOpinion.description: In the card tool's dry run, ask the tier classifier once and print its tier beside the card's (card says standard · classifier says economy); never on a dispatch. Off skips the call

wakeOnVerdict.title: Wake the brain on a verdict
wakeOnVerdict.description: Off by default: a verdict row is posted and nothing starts a turn of the brain's own; in the hand-back turn the brain calls the verdict tool, which returns the verdict once it lands. On: after the mod posts a verdict row for a worker's hand-back it also submits that row with its next action (accept, resume, the ready: line, the respawn spawn block) as a turn of the brain's own, so the brain acts without waiting for you to type; never as your words, and the engine queues it while you are mid-prompt

scopeAmends.title: Scope amends (apply | new-files | ask)
scopeAmends.description: Whether a worker's request to widen its scope (an amend block with scope+=) applies on its word. apply: appended before verifying, as the applyAmends option says; new-files: appended only when every path it names is a new file, absent at the base, in a folder a scope entry already names; ask: every scope+= block waits for you to append it to the brief and dispatch verify=<sha>. forbid+= always applies; applyAmends off still lists every block and applies none. A value here other than the default wins over the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json)

review.title: Review (off | on | on-frontier)
review.description: After a consistent verdict, a fresh read-only reviewer reads the hand-back against the diff and labels each claim confirmed, refuted or unverifiable; a refuted claim resumes the worker. on: every consistent verdict; on-frontier: only frontier and premium cards; off: nothing changes. The reviewer is one tier below the worker's (see reviewTier), never edits, and never counts against budget=. Empty or off = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else on-frontier; a value here wins over it. The one way to switch it off is "review": "off" in the repo file (or /delegation config review off when that writes the repo file)

reviewTier.title: Reviewer tier
reviewTier.description: The tier the reviewer runs at: economy, standard, frontier or premium (fable is never spawned; it becomes opus). Empty = one tier below the worker's, never below economy. Empty or 0 = the repo file (.chassis-delegation.json), else one below the worker's; a value here wins over it

readyFallbackMinutes.title: Ready fallback minutes
readyFallbackMinutes.description: A queued row the mod said ready: for that the brain has not spawned after this many minutes is started by the mod itself, but only a worktree brief (repo=here and repo=none always wait for the brain, and the ready line says how long). A mod-started worker runs outside the mod's hooks: no git guard, no effort setting, cost known only at the end. 0 = off

waitStallMin.title: Wait stall minutes
waitStallMin.description: A briefed worker that is waiting without a hand-back wakes the brain once per state, saying what it waits on. Past this many minutes the mod says once that it is stalled, and to resume or stop it. 0 = off

driveWarn.title: Drive warn row
driveWarn.description: Post one row a turn when the brain, at a large context, runs the same command a third time or polls a job, saying a standard card would drive it. Off hides the row; /delegation still counts the brain's calls by kind

driveWarnTokens.title: Drive warn context (tokens)
driveWarnTokens.description: The brain context, in tokens, from which the drive warn row speaks

freshSessionTokens.title: Fresh session context (tokens)
freshSessionTokens.description: The brain context, in tokens, at or above which the brain is told once a session to start a fresh session at the next phase boundary; 0 turns it off
